decisions.decision: Helen Balcom will continue planting the flowers at the entrance of the North and South Cemeteries for FY2023, but will not do the watering.
decisions.quote: helen balcom will continue to plant the flowers at the entrance of the north and south cemeteries for the 2023 fiscal year.

decisions.decision: Danielle Peterson will do the watering for the flowers at the North and South Cemeteries.
decisions.quote: danielle peterson will do the watering for the flowers at the north and south cemeteries.

decisions.decision: DPW will pay the outhouse expenses at the North Cemetery.
decisions.quote: the outhouse expenses at the north cemetery will be paid for by the dpw.

decisions.decision: Remaining hedge trimming at the North Cemetery will be contracted out by the DPW and paid from the DPW budget.
decisions.quote: remaining hedge trimming at the north cemetery will be contracted out by the dpw and come out of the dpw budget.

decisions.decision: The Headstones and Turf projects will be submitted to both Capital Funding and State Community Project Funding; Fixing the Walls will be submitted to State Community Project Funding.
decisions.quote: the headstones and turf projects will be submitted to both the capital funding and the state community project funding.

decisions.decision: Richard McGrath will do the Cherry Hill Cemetery stone wall.
decisions.quote: chairman tyler discussed the cherry hill cemetery stone wall will be done by richard mcgrath.
